title: A research protocol of foot posture evaluation in traffic policeman
protocol: Instruct the patient to stand in their relaxed stance position with double limb support.
Ensure the patient stands still, with arms by their side and looking straight ahead.
Palpate the talar head for assessment.
Assess supra and infra lateral malleolar curvature.
Inspect prominence in the region of talonavicular joint.
Determine congruence of the medial longitudinal arch.
Observe abduction/adduction of the forefoot on the rear foot.
Grade each component from zero to neutral, assigning a minimum score of -2 for clear signs of supination and +2 for positive signs of pronation.
